rows.date: Within 10 days from publication date on DRDO website

content_sections.heading: DRDO CVRDE Paid Internship 2026-27 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: CVRDE has announced a total of 35 internship vacancies for Undergraduate and Postgraduate Engineering students.

rows.post_name: Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Electronic & Instrumentation Engineering
Computer Science Engineering / Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning / Information Technology

content_sections.heading: DRDO CVRDE Paid Internship 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be regular students pursuing engineering degree courses from recognized Indian Universities or Institutes. B.E./B.Tech students studying in 7th or 8th semester are eligible. M.E./M.Tech students studying in 1st or 2nd year are eligible. Students must belong to relevant engineering disciplines mentioned in the notification. The candidate's age should be below 28 years as on 01 July 2026. Minimum 85% marks or 8.5 CGPA on a scale of 10. Minimum 8.5 CGPA should be maintained continuously in previous semesters.

content_sections.heading: DRDO CVRDE Internship 2026 Stipend
content_sections.text: Selected students will receive a stipend of ₹5,000 per month for the six-month internship period. The stipend will be paid in two slabs of three months duration each. Each slab will carry ₹15,000 and payment will be credited directly into the student's bank account.

content_sections.heading: DRDO CVRDE Internship 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be completely based on merit. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through their registered email ID along with joining instructions.

content_sections.heading: DRDO CVRDE Paid Internship Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates cannot apply through an online application portal. Applications must be submitted through Speed Post, Courier or Registered Post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DRDO CVRDE Internship 2026?
content_sections.text: Download the application form format from the DRDO official website. Fill the application form with correct details. Attach all required documents. Send the completed application through Speed Post/Courier/Registered Post. Mention "Application for Paid Internship" and branch code number on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for DRDO CVRDE Internship
content_sections.text: Filled application form in prescribed format Recent passport size photograph Institute Principal/Director request letter or NOC Undertaking Form All semester mark sheets Bonafide and Character Certificate Aadhaar Card copy College ID Card copy Student Biodata Awards, certificates, publications or patents (if available)

content_sections.heading: DRDO CVRDE Paid Internship 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationality students are eligible. No boarding or lodging expenses will be provided. No application fee is applicable. Students receiving any other stipend are not eligible. CVRDE/DRDO is not responsible for providing employment after completion of internship.

faq.question: Q1. What is DRDO CVRDE Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: DRDO CVRDE Paid Internship 2026 is a six-month internship programme offered by Combat Vehicles Research & Development Establishment for eligible engineering students.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for DRDO CVRDE Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Students pursuing B.E./B.Tech 7th/8th semester and M.E./M.Tech 1st/2nd year engineering courses can apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the stipend offered in DRDO CVRDE Internship?
faq.answer: Selected interns will receive ₹5,000 per month stipend.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for DRDO CVRDE Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Selection will be done on the basis of merit.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for DRDO CVRDE Internship?
faq.answer: No application fee is applicable during the application process.
